name: Sumiyoshi Heita
source:
Heita is a member in the school broadcasting club and a genius pianist, but is bad at his school studies. He is very energetic, expressive, and sweet and likable, but can also sometimes act like a child, getting angry or sulky easily. He takes a liking to Shion at first glance. He is the keyboardist in the band.

[From [url=http://blgames.ukepile.com/database/firstlive/firstlive.php]Boys' Love Games Headquarters[/url]]
